summary: Verified the UniverSpreadsheet scroll-jump bug fix (overflow-anchor:none + focus() monkey-patch with preventScroll:true). Tested via the dev preview Excel sim (/_dev/sim/13dbfa5a-...) as testagent2026 — the exact same UniverSpreadsheet component that CaseStage renders. All three ask-list items pass: (a) no window scroll jump when Univer mounts, (b) no jump on cell click / focus grab, (c) sheet still boots, cells editable, Submit visible. The specific mocktest attempt eabfed6f case_study screen could NOT be reached because the seed script (idempotent re-run) wiped all prior interview attempts including the pre-advanced case_study state — the mocktest JPM attempt now starts fresh at 'application' stage. action_items: If E1 wants the *specific* CaseStage screen tested end-to-end again, re-advance the mocktest JPM attempt (eabfed6f-7f9d-495f-9500-ce85a63d6f28) to current_stage='case_study' via direct DB update or a dedicated seed helper — the current seed_mock_test_user.py wipes user_interview_attempts on every run, so re-running it removed the pre-advanced state described in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: The focus() monkey-patch is scoped to elements inside the Univer container and uses a WeakSet to avoid double-patching — clean implementation, no memory leak risk.
MutationObserver is properly disconnected in the cleanup return of the useEffect, so unmount is safe.
overflowAnchor='none' is set inline on the container ref; no cleanup needed since the DOM node is removed on unmount.

measurements.focus_fn_preview: function scrollSafeFocus(opts) { return originalFocus.call(this, { ...(opts || {}), preventScroll: true }); }

rca of the issue: Root cause is browser's default focus() scrolling off-screen elements into view. Fix: monkey-patch focus() to always pass {preventScroll:true} on every descendant of the Univer container, plus set overflow-anchor:none to defeat scroll anchoring during heavy DOM insertion. Verified working.
